```{r}
params <- list(
  
  original_crc_de_dir =
    "data/DE_results",

  original_ucec_de_dir =
    "data/DE_results/ucec_gene_DE",

  
  crc_mrna_stability_file =
    "data/DE_results/stability_analysis/combined_primary_bootstrap_LOO_stability.csv",

  ucec_mrna_stability_file =
    "data/DE_results/ucec_gene_DE/stability_analysis/combined_primary_bootstrap_LOO_stability.csv",

  stability_flag_column =
    "bootstrap_robust_effect",

  
  output_root =
    "bootstrap_validated_downstream_analysis/results/shared_stable_gene_enrichment",

  
  fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
  logfc_cutoff = 1,

  
  minimum_query_size = 3L,

  
  run_gprofiler = TRUE,
  organism = "hsapiens",

  
  domain_scope = "custom_annotated",

  
  enrichment_sources = c(
    "GO:BP",
    "GO:MF",
    "GO:CC",
    "REAC",
    "KEGG",
    "WP",
    "CORUM",
    "HPA",
    "HP",
    "MIRNA",
    "TF"
  ),

  
  top_terms_per_query = 30L,
  exploratory_top_terms_per_query = 20L
)

required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "tibble",
  "stringr",
  "ggplot2",
  "ggrepel",
  "ggVennDiagram",
  "gprofiler2",

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required R packages: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 7
)

dir.create(
  params$output_root,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

contrast_config <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Contrast, ~Comparison_label, ~Flip_logFC,
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H", "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H", TRUE,
  "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L", "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L", FALSE
)

as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) {
    return(replace(x, is.na(x), FALSE))
  }

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(!is.na(x) & x != 0)
  }

  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in%
    c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
}
```

```{r}
save_placeholder_svg <- function(
    file,
    title,
    detail = "No results available"
) {
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.15,
      label = title,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5
    ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.10,
      label = detail,
      size = 4
    ) +
    ggplot2::xlim(-1, 1) +
    ggplot2::ylim(-1, 1) +
    ggplot2::theme_void()

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file,
    p,
    width = 8,
    height = 5,
    device = "svg"
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
read_original_de <- function(
    file,
    contrast_name,
    dataset_name,
    flip_logfc = FALSE
) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop(
      "Missing original DEG file: ",
      file
    )
  }

  tab <- read.csv(
    file,
    row.names = 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  required_columns <- c(
    "Gene",
    "logFC",
    "FDR"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tab)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns in ",
      file,
      ": ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  tab <- tab %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Gene = trimws(as.character(Gene)),
      logFC = as.numeric(logFC),
      FDR = as.numeric(FDR)
    )

  if (flip_logfc) {
    tab$logFC <- -tab$logFC
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(tab$Gene)) {
    warning(
      dataset_name,
      " ",
      contrast_name,
      ": duplicated genes were found. ",
      "The row with the smallest FDR is retained."
    )

    tab <- tab %>%
      dplyr::arrange(FDR) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  tab %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      Contrast = contrast_name,
      .before = 1
    )
}
```

```{r}
read_stability_table <- function(
    file,
    dataset_name
) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop(
      "Missing bootstrap stability file: ",
      file
    )
  }

  tab <- read.csv(
    file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  required_columns <- c(
    "Contrast",
    "Gene",
    params$stability_flag_column
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tab)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " stability table is missing columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      "\nAvailable columns: ",
      paste(names(tab), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  tab %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      Contrast = trimws(as.character(Contrast)),
      Gene = trimws(as.character(Gene)),
      bootstrap_stable = as_flag(
        .data[[params$stability_flag_column]]
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Contrast),
      Contrast != "",
      !is.na(Gene),
      Gene != ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Dataset,
      Contrast,
      Gene
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      bootstrap_stable = any(
        bootstrap_stable,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

```{r}
build_validated_de <- function(
    original_table,
    stability_table
) {
  original_table %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      stability_table %>%
        dplyr::select(
          Contrast,
          Gene,
          bootstrap_stable
        ),
      by = c(
        "Contrast",
        "Gene"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stability_record_found =
        !is.na(bootstrap_stable),

      bootstrap_stable =
        dplyr::coalesce(
          bootstrap_stable,
          FALSE
        ),

      original_significant =
        !is.na(FDR) &
        !is.na(logFC) &
        FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
        abs(logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff,

      sig =
        original_significant &
        bootstrap_stable,

      Direction = dplyr::case_when(
        sig & logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

        sig & logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

        TRUE ~
          "Not selected"
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
crc_stability <- read_stability_table(
  params$crc_mrna_stability_file,
  "CRC"
)

ucec_stability <- read_stability_table(
  params$ucec_mrna_stability_file,
  "UCEC"
)

analysis_objects <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(contrast_config))) {
  contrast_name <- contrast_config$Contrast[i]
  comparison_label <- contrast_config$Comparison_label[i]
  flip_logfc <- contrast_config$Flip_logFC[i]

  crc_original <- read_original_de(
    file.path(
      params$original_crc_de_dir,
      paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
    ),
    contrast_name = contrast_name,
    dataset_name = "CRC",
    flip_logfc = flip_logfc
  )

  ucec_original <- read_original_de(
    file.path(
      params$original_ucec_de_dir,
      paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
    ),
    contrast_name = contrast_name,
    dataset_name = "UCEC",
    flip_logfc = flip_logfc
  )

  crc_validated <- build_validated_de(
    crc_original,
    crc_stability %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Contrast == contrast_name
      )
  )

  ucec_validated <- build_validated_de(
    ucec_original,
    ucec_stability %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Contrast == contrast_name
      )
  )

  
  
  tested_background <- intersect(
    crc_original$Gene,
    ucec_original$Gene
  ) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()

  shared_table <- dplyr::inner_join(
    crc_validated %>%
      dplyr::filter(sig) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Gene,
        CRC_logFC = logFC,
        CRC_FDR = FDR,
        CRC_bootstrap_stable =
          bootstrap_stable
      ),
    ucec_validated %>%
      dplyr::filter(sig) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Gene,
        UCEC_logFC = logFC,
        UCEC_FDR = FDR,
        UCEC_bootstrap_stable =
          bootstrap_stable
      ),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Direction_consistent =
        sign(CRC_logFC) ==
        sign(UCEC_logFC),

      Direction = dplyr::case_when(
        Direction_consistent &
          CRC_logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

        Direction_consistent &
          CRC_logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

        TRUE ~
          "Opposite directions"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(Direction_consistent),
      pmax(CRC_FDR, UCEC_FDR)
    )

  consistent_shared <- shared_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Direction_consistent
    )

  queries <- list(
    All_direction_consistent =
      consistent_shared$Gene,

    Up_in_MSS_TMB_H =
      consistent_shared %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Direction ==
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(Gene),

    Down_in_MSS_TMB_H =
      consistent_shared %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Direction ==
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(Gene)
  )

  analysis_objects[[contrast_name]] <- list(
    contrast = contrast_name,
    comparison_label = comparison_label,
    crc_original = crc_original,
    ucec_original = ucec_original,
    crc_validated = crc_validated,
    ucec_validated = ucec_validated,
    background = tested_background,
    shared_table = shared_table,
    consistent_shared = consistent_shared,
    queries = queries
  )
}
```

```{r}
empty_gost_table <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    query = character(),
    significant = logical(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    term_size = integer(),
    query_size = integer(),
    intersection_size = integer(),
    precision = numeric(),
    recall = numeric(),
    source = character(),
    term_id = character(),
    term_name = character(),
    effective_domain_size = integer(),
    source_order = integer(),
    parents = character(),
    Correction_method = character(),
    Analysis_type = character(),
    Comparison = character(),
    neglog10_p = numeric(),
    term_label = character()
  )
}
```

```{r}
safe_gost <- function(
    query_list,
    background,
    comparison,
    correction_method = "g_SCS",
    significant_only = TRUE,
    analysis_type = "Confirmatory"
) {
  if (!isTRUE(params$run_gprofiler)) {
    return(
      list(
        object = NULL,
        table = empty_gost_table(),
        error = "g:Profiler analysis disabled."
      )
    )
  }

  query_list <- lapply(
    query_list,
    function(x) {
      unique(
        na.omit(
          trimws(
            as.character(x)
          )
        )
      )
    }
  )

  query_list <- query_list[
    vapply(
      query_list,
      length,
      integer(1)
    ) >= params$minimum_query_size
  ]

  background <- unique(
    na.omit(
      trimws(
        as.character(background)
      )
    )
  )

  if (length(query_list) == 0) {
    return(
      list(
        object = NULL,
        table = empty_gost_table(),
        error =
          "All query lists contained fewer than the minimum number of genes."
      )
    )
  }

  if (length(background) == 0) {
    return(
      list(
        object = NULL,
        table = empty_gost_table(),
        error = "The custom background was empty."
      )
    )
  }

  
  query_list <- lapply(
    query_list,
    intersect,
    y = background
  )

  query_list <- query_list[
    vapply(
      query_list,
      length,
      integer(1)
    ) >= params$minimum_query_size
  ]

  if (length(query_list) == 0) {
    return(
      list(
        object = NULL,
        table = empty_gost_table(),
        error =
          "No query retained the minimum number of genes after intersection with the background."
      )
    )
  }

  result_object <- tryCatch(
    gprofiler2::gost(
      query = query_list,
      organism = params$organism,
      ordered_query = FALSE,
      multi_query = FALSE,
      significant = significant_only,
      exclude_iea = FALSE,
      measure_underrepresentation = FALSE,
      evcodes = TRUE,
      user_threshold = if (significant_only) {
        params$fdr_cutoff
      } else {
        1.0
      },
      correction_method = correction_method,
      domain_scope = params$domain_scope,
      custom_bg = background,
      sources = params$enrichment_sources,
      highlight = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(result_object, "error")) {
    return(
      list(
        object = NULL,
        table = empty_gost_table(),
        error = conditionMessage(result_object)
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    is.null(result_object) ||
    is.null(result_object$result) ||
    nrow(result_object$result) == 0
  ) {
    return(
      list(
        object = result_object,
        table = empty_gost_table(),
        error = NA_character_
      )
    )
  }

  result_table <- tibble::as_tibble(
    result_object$result
  )

  
  if ("parents" %in% names(result_table)) {
    result_table$parents <- vapply(
      result_table$parents,
      function(x) {
        paste(
          as.character(x),
          collapse = "; "
        )
      },
      character(1)
    )
  }

  if ("intersection" %in% names(result_table)) {
    result_table$intersection <- vapply(
      result_table$intersection,
      function(x) {
        paste(
          as.character(x),
          collapse = "; "
        )
      },
      character(1)
    )
  }

  result_table <- result_table %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Correction_method =
        correction_method,

      Analysis_type =
        analysis_type,

      Comparison =
        comparison,

      neglog10_p =
        -log10(
          pmax(
            p_value,
            1e-300
          )
        ),

      term_label =
        paste0(
          source,
          ": ",
          stringr::str_trunc(
            term_name,
            70
          )
        )
    )

  list(
    object = result_object,
    table = result_table,
    error = NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r}
select_top_terms <- function(
    table,
    top_n
) {
  if (nrow(table) == 0) {
    return(table)
  }

  table %>%
    dplyr::group_by(query) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      p_value,
      dplyr::desc(intersection_size),
      .by_group = TRUE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(
      n = top_n
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}


plot_enrichment_dotplot <- function(
    table,
    title,
    file,
    exploratory = FALSE
) {
  if (nrow(table) == 0) {
    save_placeholder_svg(
      file,
      title,
      if (exploratory) {
        "No enrichment results returned"
      } else {
        "No statistically significant enrichment"
      }
    )

    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  plot_table <- table %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      query = dplyr::recode(
        query,
        All_direction_consistent =
          "All consistent",
        Up_in_MSS_TMB_H =
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",
        Down_in_MSS_TMB_H =
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H"
      ),
      plot_label = paste0(
        term_label,
        " [",
        query,
        "]"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      p_value
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      plot_label = factor(
        plot_label,
        levels = rev(
          unique(plot_label)
        )
      )
    )

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_table,
    ggplot2::aes(
      neglog10_p,
      plot_label
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(
        size = intersection_size,
        color = source,
        shape = query
      ),
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = if (exploratory) {
        paste0(
          "Exploratory ranking only; terms are not necessarily significant. ",
          "The x-axis uses corrected p-values."
        )
      } else {
        paste0(
          "Custom background: genes tested in both CRC and UCEC; ",
          params$domain_scope
        )
      },
      x = expression(-log[10]("corrected p-value")),
      y = NULL,
      size = "Shared genes",
      color = "Source",
      shape = "Gene query"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 11
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file,
    p,
    width = 12,
    height = max(
      7,
      0.24 * nrow(plot_table) + 2
    ),
    device = "svg",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  invisible(p)
}


plot_source_summary <- function(
    table,
    title,
    file
) {
  if (nrow(table) == 0) {
    save_placeholder_svg(
      file,
      title,
      "No statistically significant enrichment"
    )

    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  source_summary <- table %>%
    dplyr::count(
      query,
      source,
      name = "Number_of_terms"
    )

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    source_summary,
    ggplot2::aes(
      source,
      Number_of_terms,
      fill = query
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(
      position =
        ggplot2::position_dodge(
          width = 0.8
        )
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of significant terms",
      fill = "Gene query"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 11
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          angle = 35,
          hjust = 1
        ),
      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold",
          hjust = 0.5
        )
    )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file,
    p,
    width = 10,
    height = 5.5,
    device = "svg"
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
enrichment_results <- list()
error_log <- list()

for (contrast_name in names(analysis_objects)) {
  object <- analysis_objects[[contrast_name]]

  contrast_dir <- file.path(
    params$output_root,
    contrast_name
  )

  queries <- object$queries
  background <- object$background

  primary_result <- safe_gost(
    query_list = queries,
    background = background,
    comparison =
      object$comparison_label,
    correction_method = "g_SCS",
    significant_only = TRUE,
    analysis_type =
      "Confirmatory g:SCS"
  )

  fdr_result <- safe_gost(
    query_list = queries,
    background = background,
    comparison =
      object$comparison_label,
    correction_method = "fdr",
    significant_only = TRUE,
    analysis_type =
      "Sensitivity FDR"
  )

  exploratory_result <- safe_gost(
    query_list = queries,
    background = background,
    comparison =
      object$comparison_label,
    correction_method = "fdr",
    significant_only = FALSE,
    analysis_type =
      "Exploratory FDR ranking"
  )

  primary_table <- primary_result$table
  fdr_table <- fdr_result$table
  exploratory_table <-
    exploratory_result$table

  write.csv(
    primary_table,
    file.path(
      contrast_dir,
      "enrichment_confirmatory_gSCS_significant.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    fdr_table,
    file.path(
      contrast_dir,
      "enrichment_sensitivity_FDR_significant.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    exploratory_table,
    file.path(
      contrast_dir,
      "enrichment_exploratory_FDR_all_terms.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  primary_top <- select_top_terms(
    primary_table,
    params$top_terms_per_query
  )

  fdr_top <- select_top_terms(
    fdr_table,
    params$top_terms_per_query
  )

  exploratory_top <- select_top_terms(
    exploratory_table,
    params$exploratory_top_terms_per_query
  )

  write.csv(
    exploratory_top,
    file.path(
      contrast_dir,
      "enrichment_exploratory_FDR_top_terms.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  plot_enrichment_dotplot(
    primary_top,
    paste0(
      object$comparison_label,
      ": shared stable DEG enrichment (g:SCS)"
    ),
    file.path(
      contrast_dir,
      "enrichment_confirmatory_gSCS_dotplot.svg"
    ),
    exploratory = FALSE
  )

  plot_enrichment_dotplot(
    fdr_top,
    paste0(
      object$comparison_label,
      ": shared stable DEG enrichment (FDR sensitivity)"
    ),
    file.path(
      contrast_dir,
      "enrichment_sensitivity_FDR_dotplot.svg"
    ),
    exploratory = FALSE
  )

  plot_enrichment_dotplot(
    exploratory_top,
    paste0(
      object$comparison_label,
      ": top enrichment trends"
    ),
    file.path(
      contrast_dir,
      "enrichment_exploratory_FDR_top_terms.svg"
    ),
    exploratory = TRUE
  )

  plot_source_summary(
    primary_table,
    paste0(
      object$comparison_label,
      ": significant terms by source (g:SCS)"
    ),
    file.path(
      contrast_dir,
      "enrichment_confirmatory_gSCS_source_counts.svg"
    )
  )

  query_count_table <- tibble::tibble(
    Query = names(queries),
    Number_of_genes = vapply(
      queries,
      length,
      integer(1)
    )
  )

  write.csv(
    query_count_table,
    file.path(
      contrast_dir,
      "query_gene_counts.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  enrichment_results[[contrast_name]] <- list(
    primary_object =
      primary_result$object,
    primary_table =
      primary_table,
    fdr_object =
      fdr_result$object,
    fdr_table =
      fdr_table,
    exploratory_object =
      exploratory_result$object,
    exploratory_table =
      exploratory_table,
    exploratory_top =
      exploratory_top
  )

  error_log[[contrast_name]] <- tibble::tibble(
    Contrast = contrast_name,
    Analysis = c(
      "Confirmatory g:SCS",
      "Sensitivity FDR",
      "Exploratory FDR ranking"
    ),
    Error = c(
      primary_result$error,
      fdr_result$error,
      exploratory_result$error
    )
  )
}

error_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  error_log
)

write.csv(
  error_table,
  file.path(
    params$output_root,
    "gprofiler_error_log.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  error_table,
  caption = "g:Profiler query status."
)
```

```{r}
enrichment_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(enrichment_results),
    function(contrast_name) {
      result <- enrichment_results[[contrast_name]]
      object <- analysis_objects[[contrast_name]]

      tibble::tibble(
        Contrast = contrast_name,
        Comparison =
          object$comparison_label,
        Background_genes =
          length(object$background),
        Consistent_shared_genes =
          length(
            object$queries$All_direction_consistent
          ),
        Up_genes =
          length(
            object$queries$Up_in_MSS_TMB_H
          ),
        Down_genes =
          length(
            object$queries$Down_in_MSS_TMB_H
          ),
        Significant_gSCS_terms =
          nrow(result$primary_table),
        Significant_FDR_terms =
          nrow(result$fdr_table),
        Exploratory_terms_returned =
          nrow(result$exploratory_table)
      )
    }
  )
)

write.csv(
  enrichment_summary,
  file.path(
    params$output_root,
    "enrichment_result_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  enrichment_summary,
  caption =
    "Summary of shared-gene enrichment results."
)
```

```{r}
workbook_sheets <- list(
  Input_summary =
    diagnostic_summary,

  Result_summary =
    enrichment_summary,

  Error_log =
    error_table
)

for (contrast_name in names(analysis_objects)) {
  object <- analysis_objects[[contrast_name]]
  result <- enrichment_results[[contrast_name]]

  sheet_prefix <- if (
    contrast_name ==
      "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H"
  ) {
    "MSSH_vs_MSIH"
  } else {
    "MSSH_vs_MSSL"
  }

  workbook_sheets[[
    paste0(
      sheet_prefix,
      "_shared"
    )
  ]] <- object$shared_table

  workbook_sheets[[
    paste0(
      sheet_prefix,
      "_consistent"
    )
  ]] <- object$consistent_shared

  workbook_sheets[[
    paste0(
      sheet_prefix,
      "_gSCS"
    )
  ]] <- result$primary_table

  workbook_sheets[[
    paste0(
      sheet_prefix,
      "_FDR"
    )
  ]] <- result$fdr_table

  workbook_sheets[[
    paste0(
      sheet_prefix,
      "_exploratory"
    )
  ]] <- result$exploratory_top
}

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  workbook_sheets,
  file = file.path(
    params$output_root,
    "shared_bootstrap_stable_gene_enrichment.xlsx"
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```
